build_retrieval_dataset: build a RetrievalDataset instance with config and dataset type for image-text retrieval tasks
init_processors_retrieval: initialize train or eval image processors on the RetrievalDataset image database
get_valid_text_attribute: get the valid text attribute key from sample info for captions or sentences
getitem_retrieval_train: retrieve a random caption paired with an image sample for training mode
getitem_retrieval_eval: retrieve all captions paired with an image as a SampleList for evaluation mode
